title: backlog.py close leaves other items' depends_on and relates_to naming the items it deleted, so check fails
goal: backlog.py close SP drops, from every item it keeps, the depends_on and relates_to entries that name an item it deletes (a done dependency is met), and says which it changed, so backlog.py check passes right after a close; a test closes a sprint whose items other items name. Retrospective of SP-z7a5c76b: its close left four such links in EP-5p4ahbnq, ST-tngq6z2j and ST-uzqoj5du, fixed by hand.
